task_orchestrations_engine_snapshot_chec.name: task_orchestrations_engine_snapshot_check

coalesce((
        "task_orchestrations"."engine_snapshot_version" = 0
        and "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine" = 'workflow'
        and "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_version" = 'workflow-legacy-graph'
        and "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_source" = 'legacy'
        and "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot" = '{"schemaVersion":1,"engine":"workflow","engineVersion":"workflow-legacy-graph","status":"legacy","capturedAt":null,"capabilities":["durable-workflow"],"limitations":["Historical Stage 3 graph orchestration."],"unavailableReason":null}'
        and "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity" = 'null'
      ) or (
        "task_orchestrations"."engine_snapshot_version" = 1
        and "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_source" in ('per-launch', 'project', 'global', 'product')
        and length(trim("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_version")) between 1 and 128
        and (
          ("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine" = 'workflow' and "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_version" = 'workflow-v1') or
          ("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine" = 'codex-v2' and "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_version" = 'codex-v2-v1') or
          ("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine" = 'codex-v1' and "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_version" = 'codex-v1-v1')
        )
        and json_valid("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot") = 1
        and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$') = 'object'
        and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$.schemaVersion') = 'integer'
        and json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$.schemaVersion') = 1
        and json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$.engine') = "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine"
        and json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$.engineVersion') = "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_version"
        and json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$.status') = 'available'
        and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$.capturedAt') = 'text'
        and length(trim(json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$.capturedAt'))) between 1 and 128
        and julianday(json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$.capturedAt')) is not null
        and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$.capabilities') = 'array'
        and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$.limitations') = 'array'
        and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_capability_snapshot", '$.unavailableReason') = 'null'
        and json_valid("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity") = 1
        and (
          json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$') = 'null' or
          (
            json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$') = 'object'
            and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.schemaVersion') = 'integer'
            and json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.schemaVersion') = 1
            and json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.engine') = "task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine"
            and (
              ("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine" = 'workflow'
                and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.workflowRunId') = 'text'
                and length(trim(json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.workflowRunId'))) between 1 and 512) or
              ("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine" = 'codex-v2'
                and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.canonicalTaskPath') = 'text'
                and length(trim(json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.canonicalTaskPath'))) between 1 and 1024
                and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.taskName') = 'text'
                and length(trim(json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.taskName'))) between 1 and 200
                and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.providerTaskId') in ('null', 'text')
                and (json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.providerTaskId') = 'null'
                  or length(trim(json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.providerTaskId'))) between 1 and 512)) or
              ("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine" = 'codex-v1'
                and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.providerAgentId') = 'text'
                and length(trim(json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.providerAgentId'))) between 1 and 512
                and json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.nickname') in ('null', 'text')
                and (json_type("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.nickname') = 'null'
                  or length(trim(json_extract("task_orchestrations"."coordination_engine_provider_identity", '$.nickname'))) between 1 and 160))
            )
          )
        )
      ), 0)
